title: Implement Request Logger Middleware
description: This feature adds a request logger middleware to yantraverse, providing insights into incoming requests and helping with debugging and error tracking. It will log request metadata, such as method, path, and response status. This improvement enhances the framework's usability and maintainability
acceptance: The request logger middleware logs requests correctly, including metadata, and handles edge cases without errors
reason: Adding a request logger middleware is a high-impact feature that improves the framework's debuggability and maintainability, aligning with the current focus on feature development
